name: Kano Model
description: Classify and prioritize requirements from the VoC→CTx tree using the Kano method
whenToUse: When features should be classified by how much their presence raises satisfaction and their absence lowers it — must-be, performance and delight features, surveyed with the functional and the dysfunctional question per respondent; not for weighting criteria against each other, that is what the pairwise comparison is for.
sourceNone: No VoC→CTx tree in this project yet. Create one first to pull in requirements.
syncClean: Item list is up to date with the tree.
syncPending: {added} new, {renamed} renamed, {missing} no longer in the tree
syncDetached: Items are not linked to any tree.
sourceDetachedInfo: These items are not linked to any tree. Select a tree above to link them.
captureEmpty: No items yet. Pull in requirements from the tree first.
captureNoRespondent: Add a respondent to start capturing answers.
scale5: I would dislike it a lot
tieTitle: Two categories tied — the stronger category was chosen
warnQShare: High share of questionable answers ({share}) — the questions were likely misunderstood.

confirm.overwriteTree: The VoC→CTx tree in this project already has content. Overwrite it with the example tree? With “Cancel” the example loads without a tree link.
